options.name: vdom
options.description: {'Specify the Virtual Domain(s) from which results are returned or changes are applied to. If this parameter is not provided, the management VDOM will be used. If the admin does not have access to the VDOM, a permission error will be returned. The URL parameter is one of': 'vdom=root (Single VDOM) vdom=vdom1,vdom2 (Multiple VDOMs) vdom=* (All VDOMs)'}
